summary: Crypto sentiment is cautiously bullish: Bitcoin is rallying alongside Nasdaq futures, while Michaël van de Poppe remains constructive on altcoins but warns that large corrections of 50–80% remain possible. Macro markets are risk-on today, with gold and Brent crude higher, although the available results do not provide reliable same-day commentary for every requested stock, token, or FX pair.[1][2][3][4]
